title: Slide Challenge
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
Slide Challenge is a competition where you should move from point A to point B on a map as fast as possible. There was a [[Sc2004]] movie produced after the challange had come to an end

== Future ==
A new Slide Challenge largly depend on the available maps. Atm two maps (slide6 and speed) have been aproved for the next competition.

It requires to be implemented in the [[KTX]] server mod.

== History ==
Slide Challenge 2004 featured competition on five maps and a totalrank.
* [[Slide1]] - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Daan]] 19.475 seconds 
* [[Slide2]] - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[tGM]] 14.719 seconds
* [[Slide4]] - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Daan]] 16.638 seconds
* [[Slide5]] - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[HerrZ]] 19.176 seconds
* [[Slide7]] - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Phantasy]] 18.459 seconds
* Total - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Daan]] 8855.8
